params.name: vals
params.let: [m + d * t for t in pat]

stem: Calculate the standard deviation of the values: ${=vals[0]}, {=vals[1]}, {=vals[2]}, {=vals[3]}$
solution: The deviations $x-\bar{x}$ are ${=vals[0]-m}, {=vals[1]-m}, {=vals[2]-m}, {=vals[3]-m}$, and their squares are ${=d*d}, {=d*d}, {=d*d}, {=d*d}$, so $\sum (x-\bar{x})^2={=4*d*d}$
notes: Symmetric data, integer mean and integer answer. Population formula (divide by n) as in the book.
